title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30350: add OnBeforeTestFirstApplyItemLedgerEntryTracking event
summary: A new integration event OnBeforeTestFirstApplyItemLedgerEntryTracking was added to codeunit 22 so extensions can validate item tracking and optionally modify the Item Tracking Code before standard validation runs.
key_points: New integration event published at the start of TestFirstApplyItemLedgerEntryTracking procedure
Allows extensions to raise clearer, document-specific tracking validation errors
Item Tracking Code parameter is passed by var so subscribers can adjust it
Enables conditional skipping of lot checking in specific scenarios
Added across all localization layers: W1, CH, ES, IT, RU, and APAC
